subdomains.name: Daemon Subdomain (Evil)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Scythe of Evil with Whispering Evil and replace the Evil domain's 1st-, 3rd-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Touch of Evil
powers.summary: As a melee touch attack, sicken a creature for rounds equal to half cleric level. While sickened this way, it counts as good for spells with the evil descriptor. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Whispering Evil
powers.summary: As a standard action, fascinate enemies that fail a Will save within a 30-foot emanation while you continue the litany. Usable for rounds per day equal to cleric level; rounds need not be consecutive.

subdomains.name: Demon Subdomain (Chaos)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Touch of Chaos with Fury of the Abyss and replace the Chaos domain's 1st-, 3rd-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Fury of the Abyss
powers.summary: As a swift action for 1 round, gain an enhancement bonus equal to half cleric level on melee attacks, melee damage, and combat maneuvers, but take a -2 AC penalty. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Chaos Blade
powers.summary: As a standard action, give a touched weapon the anarchic special ability for rounds equal to half cleric level. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

subdomains.name: Demon Subdomain (Evil)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Touch of Evil with Fury of the Abyss and replace the Evil domain's 1st-, 3rd-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Fury of the Abyss
powers.summary: As a swift action for 1 round, gain an enhancement bonus equal to half cleric level on melee attacks, melee damage, and combat maneuvers, but take a -2 AC penalty. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Scythe of Evil
powers.summary: As a standard action, give a touched weapon the unholy special ability for rounds equal to half cleric level. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

subdomains.name: Devil Subdomain (Evil)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Touch of Evil with Hell's Corruption and replace the Evil domain's 1st-, 3rd-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Hell's Corruption
powers.summary: With a melee touch attack, impose a -2 penalty on all saves and force opposed skill checks to be rolled twice, taking the worse result, for rounds equal to half cleric level. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Scythe of Evil
powers.summary: As a standard action, give a touched weapon the unholy special ability for rounds equal to half cleric level. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

subdomains.name: Devil Subdomain (Law)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Touch of Law with Hell's Corruption and replace the Law domain's 1st-, 3rd-, and 6th-level spells.

powers.name: Hell's Corruption
powers.summary: With a melee touch attack, impose a -2 penalty on all saves and force opposed skill checks to be rolled twice, taking the worse result, for rounds equal to half cleric level. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Staff of Order
powers.summary: As a standard action, give a touched weapon the axiomatic special ability for rounds equal to half cleric level. Usable once per day at 8th level, plus once per four levels beyond 8th.

subdomains.name: Ash Subdomain (Fire)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Fire Resistance with Wall of Ashes and replace the Fire domain's 7th- and 9th-level spells.

powers.name: Fire Bolt
powers.summary: As a standard action, make a ranged touch attack against a foe within 30 feet. It deals 1d6 fire damage plus 1 for every two cleric levels. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Wall of Ashes
powers.summary: Create a sight-blocking wall within 100 feet for minutes per day equal to cleric level. Creatures passing through may be blinded, and the ash reveals invisible creatures in or adjacent to the wall.

subdomains.name: Smoke Subdomain (Fire)
subdomains.benefit: Replace Fire Bolt with Cloud of Smoke and replace the Fire domain's 2nd- and 3rd-level spells.

powers.name: Cloud of Smoke
powers.summary: As a standard action, create a 5-foot-radius smoke cloud within 30 feet. It grants concealment and penalizes attacks and Perception while creatures remain inside and for 1 round after. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Fire Resistance
powers.summary: Gain fire resistance 10 at 6th level, increasing to 20 at 12th level and immunity at 20th level.
